The position will ensure that program and project activities are effectively monitored, that reliable and quality data is generated and analyzed, and that evidence is used to inform program improvement, decision-making, accountability, and organizational learning. The Senior M&E Officer will work closely with program teams, management, partners, field staff, and other stakeholders to develop appropriate M&E systems, track performance against targets and indicators, identify implementation challenges, and provide evidence-based recommendations. Key Responsibilities A. Monitoring and Evaluation Systems Develop, strengthen, and maintain effective monitoring and evaluation systems, tools, procedures, and frameworks. Support the development and review of project logframes, theories of change, results frameworks, performance indicators, and M&E plans. Ensure that project indicators are clearly defined, measurable, realistic, and aligned with project objectives and donor requirements. Develop appropriate data collection tools, reporting templates, monitoring checklists, and data management systems. Establish mechanisms for routine monitoring of program activities, outputs, outcomes, and impact. Ensure that M&E systems are practical, user-friendly, and consistently implemented across project locations. B. Data Collection and Quality Assurance Lead and coordinate quantitative and qualitative data collection activities. Develop data collection methodologies and ensure appropriate sampling and data collection procedures. Conduct regular field monitoring visits to verify project implementation and data. Implement data quality assurance processes to ensure data is accurate, complete, reliable, timely, and consistent. Conduct routine Data Quality Assessments (DQAs) and address identified data quality issues. Train project staff and field teams on data collection, reporting, and M&E procedures. Ensure that appropriate ethical standards and confidentiality requirements are followed during data collection and management. C. Data Management and Analysis Develop and maintain organized databases for project and organizational performance data. Ensure timely collection, entry, cleaning, validation, storage, and management of project data. Analyze quantitative and qualitative data to identify trends, patterns, achievements, gaps, and emerging issues. Produce dashboards, tables, charts, and other data visualization products for management and program teams. Maintain accurate and up-to-date indicator tracking systems. Ensure that data is securely stored and accessible to authorized personnel. D. Reporting Coordinate the preparation of periodic M&E reports and performance updates. Provide accurate data and analysis for donor reports, management reports, project reviews, and organizational reporting. Track project performance against agreed targets and milestones. Highlight underperformance, implementation gaps, risks, and areas requiring management attention. Provide evidence-based recommendations to improve project performance. Support the preparation of annual reports, project completion reports, and other organizational reports. E. Evaluations, Assessments and Research Support or lead baseline, midline, endline, impact assessments, and other evaluations. Develop evaluation methodologies, tools, data collection plans, and analysis frameworks. Coordinate external consultants and evaluation teams where required. Conduct needs assessments, surveys, studies, and operational research. Ensure that evaluation findings are clearly documented and communicated to relevant stakeholders. Support the implementation of recommendations arising from evaluations and assessments. F. Program Performance Monitoring Work closely with program teams to monitor implementation progress against workplans and targets. Conduct routine monitoring visits to project sites and activities. Verify reported achievements and identify implementation challenges. Participate in project review meetings and provide evidence-based performance analysis. Identify opportunities to improve program effectiveness, efficiency, relevance, and sustainability. Provide timely feedback to program teams based on monitoring findings. G. Learning and Knowledge Management Promote a culture of evidence-based decision-making and continuous learning. Document lessons learned, best practices, success stories, challenges, and innovations. Facilitate learning sessions, reflection meetings, and program review workshops. Ensure that findings from monitoring, evaluations, research, and community feedback are used to improve programming. Develop and maintain systems for sharing M&E knowledge across the organization. Support adaptive management by providing timely evidence to guide program adjustments. H. Accountability and Feedback Support the development and implementation of community feedback and accountability mechanisms. Monitor whether beneficiaries and stakeholders are adequately informed and able to provide feedback. Analyze community feedback and complaints and identify trends requiring programmatic action. Ensure that feedback from beneficiaries is incorporated into program improvement processes. Promote transparency, accountability, and participation in program implementation. I. Capacity Building Train program and field staff on monitoring, evaluation, data collection, data quality, and reporting requirements. Provide technical support and mentorship to junior M&E staff. Develop user-friendly M&E guidance materials and standard operating procedures. Strengthen the capacity of project teams to use data for planning and decision-making. Promote consistent application of M&E standards across projects and departments. J. Donor and Stakeholder Engagement Support compliance with donor M&E and reporting requirements. Participate in donor meetings, project reviews, assessments, and evaluations as required. Provide accurate and timely performance information to donors and partners. Support the development of donor indicators, reporting frameworks, and performance measurement plans. Ensure that M&E systems comply with contractual and organizational requirements. Required profile for job ad : Senior Monitoring and Evaluation Officer - Kigali Qualifications and Experience Education Master's degree in Monitoring and Evaluation, Statistics, Economics, Development Studies, Social Sciences, Public Health, Research Methods, Data Science, or a related field. Professional training or certification in M&E, project management, data analysis, or research methods is desirable. Experience At least 5 years of relevant professional experience in monitoring and evaluation, research, data management, program performance, or a related field. Demonstrated experience designing and implementing M&E systems for projects or programs. Experience conducting quantitative and qualitative research and evaluations. Experience developing and managing databases and data collection systems. Experience with donor-funded projects and donor reporting requirements is an advantage. Previous experience supervising or mentoring M&E staff is desirable. Experience working with NGOs, international development organizations, government institutions, or research organizations is an advantage. Technical Skills The successful candidate should have strong knowledge and experience in: Monitoring and evaluation methodologies. Results-based management. Logical frameworks and theories of change. Indicator development and performance measurement. Quantitative and qualitative research methods. Data collection and data quality assurance. Statistical analysis and interpretation. Survey design and sampling techniques. Database management and data visualization. Evaluation design and implementation. Report writing and evidence-based analysis. Knowledge management and organizational learning. Software and Tools Proficiency in relevant data and analytical tools such as: Microsoft Excel Power BI or other data visualization platforms SPSS, Stata, R, or similar statistical software KoboToolbox, ODK, CommCare, SurveyCTO, or similar digital data collection platforms Microsoft Word and PowerPoint Key Competencies Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills. Excellent attention to detail. Strong data interpretation and problem-solving abilities. Excellent report-writing and presentation skills. Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to translate complex data into clear and practical recommendations. Strong organizational and time-management skills. Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities. Strong facilitation and training skills. Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary teams. High level of integrity and commitment to data accuracy and confidentiality. Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines. Key Performance Indicators Performance will be assessed against indicators including: Timeliness and quality of M&E reports. Accuracy, completeness, and reliability of program data. Percentage of projects with functional M&E systems. Timeliness of data collection and reporting. Completion of planned monitoring visits and assessments. Quality and utilization of performance dashboards and analysis. Implementation of data quality assurance processes. Timely completion of baseline, midline, endline, and other evaluations. Extent to which M&E findings are used for program improvement. Capacity of program staff to implement M&E requirements. Quality and timeliness of donor performance reporting. Review telematics daily for movement outside working hours or assigned zones, unauthorised trips and personal use. Request fuel or charging exceptions in writing only when justified (for example, a confirmed booking that would otherwise be lost). Support investigations into revenue gaps, unusual fuel use or red flags raised by the Controlling branch. Use vehicles, fuel and driver hours efficiently to protect the product's margin. 7. Reporting & Weekly Product Review Prepare a weekly operations report: deployment against hotel occupancy, vehicle use, misuse cases, service issues and customer feedback. Attend the weekly Product Review, agree actions and deliver them by the dates in the action log. Provide operational commentary for the monthly product P&L.
